mainEntity.name: When should I involve a contractor like Frasheski Construction for plumbing and electrical planning in my addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is best to involve a general contractor during the initial design phase of your addition. Early involvement allows for integrated planning, where plumbing and electrical layouts are considered alongside structural elements and architectural designs. This proactive approach helps identify potential issues before construction begins, streamlining the permit process and minimizing changes during the build. Our experience in the East Bay ensures a smooth transition from design to construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Involve your general contractor during the initial design phase to integrate plumbing and electrical plans early, preventing issues and streamlining the permit process.
